2027-01-15.title: Friday of the First Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Let us make every effort to enter that rest
Do not forget the works of the Lord
The Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins
2027-01-15.alt: Weekday of Ordinary Time, Week 1 (Year I). Liturgical colour: green.
2027-01-15.verse: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
theo: The house in Capernaum is so full that four men cannot bring their paralysed friend to Jesus. So they climb onto the roof, dig through it and lower him down on his mat. Mark says: “When Jesus saw their faith”, the faith of the four friends, he spoke to the paralytic. And his first words surprise everyone: “Son, your sins are forgiven.” Jesus goes first to the deepest paralysis, sin. The scribes object: who can forgive sins but God alone? They are right about God, and wrong about Jesus.

To show that “the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”, Jesus tells the man to take up his mat and walk, and he does. Everyone is amazed: “We have never seen anything like this!” Hebrews speaks of the “rest” God promised, which the wilderness generation failed to enter through unbelief, and urges: “Let us therefore make every effort to enter that rest.” Forgiveness is the beginning of that rest. In the sacrament of Reconciliation Christ still says: your sins are forgiven; rise and walk.
outline: Ask: who are the four friends who have carried you to Jesus?
Faith that does not give up.
live: Bring someone to Jesus this week: by prayer, an invitation to Mass or a visit.
Go to confession before the end of the month.
2027-01-15.prayer: Lord Jesus, you saw the faith of four friends and forgave the paralysed man. Thank you for those who have carried me to you. Forgive my sins, raise me up, and let me carry others to you. Amen.
altar: Before Communion we pray: “Lord, I am not worthy… but only say the word.” The One who forgave the paralytic speaks the same word to us.

quick: Four friends carry the paralytic to Jesus.
He has authority on earth to forgive.
2027-01-15.action: Bring someone to Jesus this week.
2027-01-15.question: Whom am I carrying to Jesus by my faith?

family.explain: Four friends carried a man who could not walk. The house was full, so they made a hole in the roof and let him down to Jesus! Jesus forgave his sins and healed him.
family.intention: We pray for a friend who needs Jesus.
family.ask: Ask: “Which friend can we pray for and help to know Jesus?”

illus: A group of four college friends in Thrissur noticed that one of their classmates had stopped coming to classes and was sinking into depression. They took turns visiting him, studying with him and finally brought him to a retreat. He says: I could not walk to God myself; they carried me through the roof.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, you saw the faith of the four friends. Look at our faith as we gather, and forgive and heal us. Amen.
share: When Jesus saw their faith (Mark 2:5). Whose faith has carried me?
Son, your sins are forgiven (Mark 2:5). Do I believe Jesus forgives me?
Let us make every effort to enter that rest (Hebrews 4:11). What keeps me from God's rest?
interc: For those who are paralysed by sin, fear or illness.
For friends who carry others to Christ.
For those who have not received the sacrament of Reconciliation for many years.
For our group, that our faith may carry others.
pm.close: Father, your Son has authority to forgive sins. Forgive us, raise us up, and make us friends who carry others to him. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, the house in Capernaum is packed. Four men arrive carrying a paralysed friend on a mat. They cannot get near Jesus. So they climb the roof, dig through it and lower their friend right in front of Jesus.
Mark says: when Jesus saw their faith (Mark 2:5). The faith of the friends matters. We are saved as a people, carried by others' prayers and love.

Then Jesus says something unexpected: son, your sins are forgiven. He sees the deepest paralysis. The scribes think: who can forgive sins but God alone? They are right about God. They do not see that God is standing in front of them.
To show his authority, Jesus says: stand up, take your mat and go. And the man walks out before them all. Everyone says: we have never seen anything like this! (Mark 2:12).

Hebrews invites us: let us make every effort to enter God's rest (Hebrews 4:11). Forgiveness is the door. Let us go to confession, and let us be the four friends for someone who cannot reach Jesus alone. Amen.
kids: Children, four friends carried a sick man to Jesus, even through a roof! Jesus forgave him and made him walk. Can you bring a friend to Jesus by praying for them?

intro: Faith that carries others, forgiveness that heals, rest that God promises.

sub: Four friends dig through the roof.
q: But Ruth said, “Do not press me to leave you or to turn back from following you! Where you go, I will go; where you lodge, I will lodge; your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
points.apply: Pray daily this week for one friend far from God.

q: I, I am He who blots out your transgressions for my own sake, and I will not remember your sins.
And he stood up, and immediately took the mat and went out before all of them; so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”
points.apply: Go to confession before the end of January.

q: And on the seventh day God finished the work that he had done, and he rested on the seventh day from all the work that he had done.
Let us therefore make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one may fall through such disobedience as theirs.
points.apply: Keep Sunday this week as a true day of rest and worship.

concl: Let us be carried, and let us carry others.
2027-01-15.resolve: Bring one friend to Jesus by prayer and invitation this week.
